# Concord Energy Strategies (Concord LP)

Clean energy tax incentive consulting firm, Louisville, Kentucky, founded 2009.

Website: https://www.concordlp.com

- 179D Tax Deduction: https://www.concordlp.com/179d-tax-deduction

- Section 6418 Transferable Tax Credits: https://www.concordlp.com/transferable-tax-credits

- Prevailing Wage and Apprenticeship Compliance: https://www.concordlp.com/prevailing-wage-apprenticeship

- R&D Tax Credits: https://www.concordlp.com/rd-tax-credits

- $1B+ in client savings secured

- 100% audit success rate

- 15+ years focused exclusively on clean energy tax incentives

- 1,000+ buildings evaluated annually
